verses.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.pt: Portanto, nós também, pois estamos rodeados de tão grande nuvem de testemunhas, deixemos todo embaraço, e o pecado que tão de perto nos rodeia, e corramos com perseverança a carreira que nos está proposta,
verses.en_web: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, as we are circled by so great a cloud of witnesses, putting off every weight, and the sin into which we come so readily, let us keep on running in the way which is marked out for us,

verses.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.pt: fitando os olhos em Jesus, autor e consumador da nossa fé, o qual, pelo gozo que lhe está proposto, suportou a cruz, desprezando a ignomínia, e está assentado à direita do trono de Deus.
verses.en_web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.en_bbe: Having our eyes fixed on Jesus, the guide and end of our faith, who went through the pains of the cross, not caring for the shame, because of the joy which was before him, and who has now taken his place at the right hand of God's seat of power.

verses.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.pt: Considerai, pois aquele que suportou tal contradição dos pecadores contra si mesmo, para que não vos canseis, desfalecendo em vossas almas.
verses.en_web: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
verses.en_bbe: Give thought to him who has undergone so much of the hate of sinners against himself, so that you may not be tired and feeble of purpose.

verses.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.pt: Ainda não resististes até o sangue, combatendo contra o pecado;
verses.en_web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;
verses.en_bbe: Till now you have not given your blood in your fight against sin:

verses.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
verses.pt: e já vos esquecestes da exortação que vos admoesta como a filhos: Filho meu, não desprezes a correção do Senhor, nem te desanimes quando por ele és repreendido;
verses.en_web: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
verses.en_bbe: And you have not kept in mind the word which says to you as to sons, My son, do not make little of the Lord's punishment, and do not give up hope when you are judged by him;

verses.en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.pt: pois o Senhor corrige ao que ama, e açoita a todo o que recebe por filho.
verses.en_web: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord sends punishment on his loved ones; everyone whom he takes as his son has experience of his rod.

verses.en: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.pt: É para disciplina que sofreis; Deus vos trata como a filhos; pois qual é o filho a quem o pai não corrija?
verses.en_web: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
verses.en_bbe: It is for your training that you undergo these things; God is acting to you as a father does to his sons; for what son does not have punishment from his father?

verses.en: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.pt: Mas, se estais sem disciplina, da qual todos se têm tornado participantes, sois então bastardos, e não filhos.
verses.en_web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.
verses.en_bbe: But if you have not that punishment of which we all have our part, then you are not true sons, but children of shame.

verses.en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.pt: Além disto, tivemos nossos pais segundo a carne, para nos corrigirem, e os olhavamos com respeito; não nos sujeitaremos muito mais ao Pai dos espíritos, e viveremos?
verses.en_web: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.en_bbe: And again, if the fathers of our flesh gave us punishment and had our respect, how much more will we be under the authority of the Father of spirits, and have life?

verses.en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.pt: Pois aqueles por pouco tempo nos corrigiam como bem lhes parecia, mas este, para nosso proveito, para sermos participantes da sua santidade.
verses.en_web: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
verses.en_bbe: For they truly gave us punishment for a short time, as it seemed good to them; but he does it for our profit, so that we may become holy as he is.

verses.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.pt: Na verdade, nenhuma correção parece no momento ser motivo de gozo, porém de tristeza; mas depois produz um fruto pacífico de justiça nos que por ele têm sido exercitados.
verses.en_web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
verses.en_bbe: At the time all punishment seems to be pain and not joy: but after, those who have been trained by it get from it the peace-giving fruit of righteousness.

verses.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.pt: Portanto levantai as mãos cansadas, e os joelhos vacilantes,
verses.en_web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
verses.en_bbe: For this cause let the hands which are hanging down be lifted up, and let the feeble knees be made strong,

verses.en: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.pt: e fazei veredas direitas para os vossos pés, para que o que é manco não se desvie, antes seja curado.
verses.en_web: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
verses.en_bbe: And make straight roads for your feet, so that the feeble may not be turned out of the way, but may be made strong.

verses.en: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.pt: Segui a paz com todos, e a santificação, sem a qual ninguém verá o Senhor,
verses.en_web: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
verses.en_bbe: Let your desire be for peace with all men, and to be made holy, without which no man may see the Lord;

verses.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verses.pt: tendo cuidado de que ninguém se prive da graça de Deus, e de que nenhuma raiz de amargura, brotando, vos perturbe, e por ela muitos se contaminem;
verses.en_web: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;
verses.en_bbe: Looking with care to see that no man among you in his behaviour comes short of the grace of God; for fear that some bitter root may come up to be a trouble to you, and that some of you may be made unclean by it;

verses.en: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.pt: e ninguém seja devasso, ou profano como Esaú, que por uma simples refeição vendeu o seu direito de primogenitura.
verses.en_web: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
verses.en_bbe: And that there may not be any evil liver, or any man without respect for God, like Esau, who let his birthright go for a plate of food.

verses.en: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.pt: Porque bem sabeis que, querendo ele ainda depois herdar a bênção, foi rejeitado; porque não achou lugar de arrependimento, ainda que o buscou diligentemente com lágrimas.
verses.en_web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
verses.en_bbe: For you have knowledge that even long after, when he was desiring the blessing for his heritage, he was turned away, though he made his request frequently and with weeping; because the past might not be changed.

verses.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.pt: Pois não tendes chegado ao monte palpável, aceso em fogo, e à escuridão, e às trevas, e à tempestade,
verses.en_web: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
verses.en_bbe: You have not come to a mountain which may be touched, and is burning with fire, and to a black cloud, and a dark smoke, and a violent wind,

verses.en: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.pt: e ao sonido da trombeta, e à voz das palavras, a qual os que a ouviram rogaram que não se lhes falasse mais;
verses.en_web: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
verses.en_bbe: And to the sound of a horn, and the voice of words, the hearers of which made request that not a word more might be said to them:

verses.en: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.pt: porque não podiam suportar o que se lhes mandava: Se até um animal tocar o monte, será apedrejado.
verses.en_web: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”;
verses.en_bbe: For the order which said, If the mountain is touched even by a beast, the beast is to be stoned, seemed hard to them;

verses.en: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.pt: E tão terrível era a visão, que Moisés disse: Estou todo aterrorizado e trêmulo.
verses.en_web: and so fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
verses.en_bbe: And the vision was so overpowering that even Moses said, I am shaking and full of fear.

verses.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.pt: Mas tendes chegado ao Monte Sião, e à cidade do Deus vivo, à Jerusalém celestial, a miríades de anjos;
verses.en_web: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
verses.en_bbe: But you have come to the mountain of Zion, to the place of the living God, to the Jerusalem which is in heaven, and to an army of angels which may not be numbered,

verses.en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.pt: à universal assembléia e igreja dos primogênitos inscritos nos céus, e a Deus, o juiz de todos, e aos espíritos dos justos aperfeiçoados;
verses.en_web: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.en_bbe: To the great meeting and church of the first of those who are named in heaven, and to God the judge of all, and to the spirits of good men made complete,

verses.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
verses.pt: e a Jesus, o mediador de um novo pacto, e ao sangue da aspersão, que fala melhor do que o de Abel.
verses.en_web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
verses.en_bbe: And to Jesus by whom the new agreement has been made between God and man, and to the sign of the blood which says better things than Abel's blood.

verses.en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
verses.pt: Vede que não rejeiteis ao que fala; porque, se não escaparam aqueles quando rejeitaram o que sobre a terra os advertia, muito menos escaparemos nós, se nos desviarmos daquele que nos adverte lá dos céus;
verses.en_web: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
verses.en_bbe: See that you give ear to his voice which comes to you. For if those whose ears were shut to the voice which came to them on earth did not go free from punishment, what chance have we of going free if we give no attention to him whose voice comes from heaven?

verses.en: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.pt: a voz do qual abalou então a terra; mas agora tem ele prometido, dizendo: Ainda uma vez hei de abalar não só a terra, mas também o céu.
verses.en_web: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
verses.en_bbe: Whose voice was the cause of the shaking of the earth; but now he has made an oath, saying, There will be still one more shaking, not only of the earth, but of heaven.

verses.en: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.pt: Ora, esta palavra - Ainda uma vez - significa a remoção das coisas abaláveis, como coisas criadas, para que permaneçam as coisas inabaláveis.
verses.en_web: This phrase, “Yet once more”, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
verses.en_bbe: And the words, Still one more, make it clear that there will be a taking away of those things which are shaking, as of things which are made, so that there may be only those things of which no shaking is possible.

verses.en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.pt: Pelo que, recebendo nós um reino que não pode ser abalado, retenhamos a graça, pela qual sirvamos a Deus agradavelmente, com reverência e temor;
verses.en_web: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
verses.en_bbe: If then, we have a kingdom which will never be moved, let us have grace, so that we may give God such worship as is pleasing to him with fear and respect:

verses.en: For our God is a consuming fire.
verses.pt: pois o nosso Deus é um fogo consumidor.
verses.en_web: for our God is a consuming fire.
verses.en_bbe: For our God is an all-burning fire.
